# App events and webhooks: is this moment mine?

## What this region is

How a business write reaches the outside world: typed app events whose handlers fan out to email, WebSocket, observation and callbacks after commit, and signed outbound webhooks that the mutation hook system fires for enabled models and delivers through jobs.

## What it exists for

- Trigger a side effect (email, notification, job, push) after a domain write
- Push a realtime update from the server to connected clients
- Decide which model changes emit webhooks and to whom
- Deliver webhooks and validate subscriber URLs

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- Use a different provider in prod than locally → adapters-integrations
- Send an email to the user → email-delivery
- Save an email template → email-templates
- Push this to every subscriber on all servers → ws-connections
- Make the page update when this changes → ws-channels
